description: Animated live flow between solar, grid, battery, home and EV, with self-sufficiency and electricity price.
aiSummary: Use when the home has a grid meter (HAN/P1) or solar production; nodes without a binding are hidden, so bind only what exists.

evName.description: Label for the EV/heavy-load node, e.g. 'Car' or 'Heat pump'

invertGrid.description: Set true when the grid sensor reports export as positive (default: positive = import)

invertBattery.description: Set true when the battery sensor reports charging as positive (default: positive = discharging)

maxPowerKw.description: Power at which the flow animation reaches full speed

currency.description: Price unit shown next to the electricity price
